title: Claims Handler
description:
Spotlightjobs is recruiting for an experienced Recoveries Claims Handler to join an expanding team of Credit Hire professionals. As a Recoveries Handler, you'll take end-to-end ownership of non-fault motor insurance claims, applying sound technical judgement, commercial awareness, and effective negotiation to drive the right outcomes.

This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role where you'll manage your own caseload, assess liability, make confident decisions, and keep claims progressing through effective collaboration with suppliers, partners, and third parties. You'll balance commercial outcomes with customer fairness, ensuring claims are managed accurately, compliantly, and with care.

You'll be joining a collaborative and supportive team that values your contributions, encourages the sharing of insights and ideas, and is committed to continuous improvement. We offer ongoing technical training and development opportunities, giving you the platform to build your expertise and grow your career in Recoveries
- Manage non fault repair, recovery, and uninsured loss claims from start to finish.
- Assess liability, indemnity, and claim financials, making accurate and timely decisions.
- Keep files moving by identifying opportunities, managing risks, and avoiding delays.
- Maintain accurate and up to date reserves and claim records.

Commercial & Financial Decision Making
- Make decisions that maximise recoveries and minimise costs.
- Negotiate subrogated outlays and manage aged debt effectively.
- Issue outlay requests and proactively follow up to ensure settlement.
- Process and authorise payments within delegated authority.

Supplier & Partner Engagement
- Work closely with suppliers, solicitors, and partners to progress claims.
- Instruct panel solicitors where escalation or litigation is required.
- Handle inbound calls from customers, third parties, suppliers, and solicitors, delivering a clear and professional customer experience.

Continuous Improvement
- Share insight, support improvements, and contribute to positive change within the Recoveries team.
- Represent the team positively in all interactions.

What We're Looking For

Technical & Commercial Skills
- A good understanding of motor insurance, non fault processes, liability, and subrogation.
- Strong technical grounding with regulatory awareness, GTA & Non GTA
- Confident and strong negotiation and influencing skills.

Personal Qualities
- Strong attention to detail with an analytical mindset.
- Proactive, self motivated, and comfortable taking ownership.
- Able to manage pressure, deadlines, and competing priorities.
- Clear, confident communicator who's comfortable making decisions.

Successful candidates will enjoy a competitive basic salary plus a lucrative monthly bonus upto £750 per month.

Full or Part-time hours available

For more information, call Allison Coe for a confidential discussion.

title: Enforcement Paralegal - Debt Recovery
description:
Enforcement Paralegal

Liverpool Permanent Full-time

Standard 8 is recruiting a Paralegal to join an established Enforcement team in Liverpool.

This is a practical litigation support role where you'll work alongside fee earners dealing with live enforcement matters. You won't spend your day watching from the sidelines. You'll be speaking with clients and other parties, preparing correspondence, helping with legal documents and keeping matters moving.

The team can consider candidates at different stages of their legal career, so previous paralegal experience isn't essential. What matters is that you're organised, comfortable dealing with people and capable of working accurately when there are deadlines to meet.

- You'll support fee earners with the day-to-day running of enforcement matters, including speaking with clients and third parties by telephone, drafting correspondence and assisting with the preparation of legal documents.

What we're looking for
- Some previous experience in a legal environment would be useful, but it isn't essential. The same applies to formal legal qualifications.
- You'll need strong written and verbal communication skills, a professional telephone manner and the confidence to deal with clients and other parties.
- You should be comfortable using Microsoft Office and generally competent with systems and technology. Previous experience of Proclaim or another case management system would be an advantage rather than a requirement.
- There is genuine scope to develop within the team for somebody who proves they can handle the work.

The firm also provides training and development and carries out annual remuneration reviews

They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Reporting potential risks identified Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights . Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work . Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly.
